about_the_game:
Premium Battle pass will allow you to get a lot of valuable rewards:
  • Themed 3D styles and camouflage;
  • Tools and components to improve your gear;
  • Additional Premium days;
  • Reset Essences and more.

Note!
  • This seasonal Battle Pass can only be purchased once per account;
  • This seasonal Battle Pass is personal;
  • The Battle Pass will be activated automatically upon receipt on the character;
  • If at the time of purchase you have already activated a Battle Pass in the game, then its cost will be refunded to you in Stalcoins by letter to the in-game mail;
  • This Battle Pass is not cross-platform and can only be used on Steam;
  • The Battle Pass can only be granted to the same Steam account that was used to made the purchase. If you have some issues, contact our EXBO Support;
  • EXBO may update, replace, or remove in-game content at any time.
